description: S459 round 3 HIGH-1: an unrefined edit buffer copied from a refined cell (`@draft = @ls`), path-edited (`@draft[0] = 5`), extended in place with a value the refined type refuses (`@draft.push(-5)`), then committed (`@ls = @draft`) in three separate events. The commit is a whole new value and is judged whole: -5 is refused and @ls keeps [1, 2]. In round 2 the copy-on-write fact left by `@draft[0] = 5` survived the unrelated events and the commit was judged only at index 0, so @ls became [5, 2, -5].
rationale: §53.3.3: the check runs before the assignment is applied and a refused value is not applied. §53.11: a runtime check is emitted for every boundary-zone assignment the compiler cannot statically elide — a check narrowed to part of the value must be proven to cover everything that changed.
